_note: Episode 47 (S5E6), story version 2, Kabanata 47: the second wish (one night in which everyone is safe) spoken at the top of the mast of Kapitan Totoy's ark; the rain stops, the white moon, the fleet singing; the whole family on the pier (Lola Ising, Inay, Itay/Teddy, Tala, Usman); the pabitin recalled (Usman's paw, Jack, Lola's tray); the walk with M under the red umbrella; a closing door and the morning (restraint: nothing explicit, M fully dressed in the morning); the new small light in Mga Kakampi. Indio is in his forties. Prompts setting first; the free endpoint refuses brick, violet, museum, mud, scroll and fighting words. Shots follow sentences.json; k90-k99 are montage extras.
